MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable hard drive feels like a useful next step after my repeated memory-card and card-reader purchases because it would let me back up photos and files.",
    "The streaming stick and HDMI cable connect to my existing TV use: streaming would add a capability, and the cable could help connect devices if I need that length. My 720p TV does not make 4K a deciding benefit."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and displays assume I want voice assistance or a dedicated calling screen, but my tablet purchase does not establish either need.",
    "Photography tripods and a lens cap do not imply a need for security cameras, and ordinary power strips do not imply an interest in Alexa-controlled plugs.",
    "The internal SSD requires a compatible computer and an upgrade plan I have not shown; the portable drive has a clearer use with my memory cards."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as broad interest in Amazon smart-home devices, although I mainly bought accessories to support the tablet.",
    "Broad connections such as cameras, storage, and power seem to outweigh the specific jobs I need those products to perform."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories for devices I already use, including mounts, cables, memory cards, cases, and a card reader.",
    "Compatibility and immediate usefulness matter: connector type, supported device, and portable versus internal storage can determine whether an item fits my needs.",
    "My recent lens-cap purchase continues my photography-accessory pattern, while nothing in my history establishes a current need for home automation."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my storage and TV needs but overread my device purchases as interest in a smart-home setup."
}
